verdict.rationale: Simular documents one recovery mechanism: saved skill code "heals itself," and when a step breaks because the UI changed, the agent takes over from that point. This addresses failed actions and UI drift, but only as a single marketing-level claim. missing for 10: documented retry semantics (counts, backoff, failure states), explicit popup/dialog handling, recovery from state drift beyond UI changes, API-level error and retry behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
